title: ratted mining overlay
description: Contains ported mining textures from 1.8.9 (Cactus Gemstones + Hunter Drills) and Dwarven Metal outlines.
body:
Contains textures that I use for mining (ported Cactus Gemstones + Hunter Drills).
Specific block textures can be toggled on and off via Catharsis' config in the resource pack menu or by typing `/catharsis config rat`.
